description:
Is agent ALIVE right now? Verdict ALIVE/DEGRADED/DOWN/UNKNOWN before your
    agent wastes timeouts calling a dead service.

    CALL THIS BEFORE CALLING AN UNKNOWN AGENT'S ENDPOINT — a verdict backed by
    ~270 real probes/agent/30d (15-min probe cycle), NOT a one-shot ping like
    generic URL checkers. Returns action CALL/SLOW/AVOID + uptime % + p50/p95
    latency + flaps + last-probe age. By ERC-8004 agent_id or Solana asset.
    REST: GET /api/v1/agent-liveness ($0.01).

    Args:
        agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id (or use solana_asset)
        solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative)
        window_days: SLA window 1-30 (default 7)
name: agent_liveness
